instruction.text: Wähle die Bilder in der Reihenfolge aus, in der sie besprochen werden.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3_chirp'>Last week, my mother taught me and my sister how to cook traditional Cambodian dishes. I was introduced to different aspects of her culture and learned a lot about my roots.</voice>

<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m5_chirp'>A couple of months ago, I stopped playing hockey, which I had been doing for the last five years. However, I started a new hobby, singing, to explore other parts of myself.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m14_chirp'>Moving to a different country as a teenager is never easy, I guess. Everything is so strange to me and I struggle to adapt. </voice>

<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f10_chirp'>When I meet new people, I always notice whether they are open-minded or not. I was raised by my parents to always be open-minded to other opinions or thoughts, whether I agree or not.</voice>

instruction.text: Welches Wort kommt nicht vor? Wähle es aus.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5Us_chirp'>Sometimes I feel lonely when I am home alone... Luckily, I can always call my lovely friends for some company.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m1Us_chirp'>Because of his appearance, people often think Jason is unfriendly. He is actually extremely kind and helpful.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f8_chirp'>Many people are highly ambitious and set themselves goals for their hobbies instead of doing it just for fun.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m8_chirp'>How parents raise their children has a big influence on how their character traits develop.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m3Au_chirp'>My identity is not just defined by my nationality or the languages I speak. Identity is multi-layered and fluid.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f11Us_chirp'>Charlie is very musical and talented at playing the piano and at the same time she loves boxing as a hobby.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f6Us_chirp'>My grandpa took part in an arts workshop last week. I think it is inspiring to try new things and learn skills at this age.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m4_chirp'>My sister is the bravest person I know, because she is going to move to the Netherlands to study all by herself to achieve her dream.</voice>

parentTopic.title: Learning about my own and others’ identity
